slides.title: Aid cuts leave refugee children exposed
slides.body: A new UNHCR-Oxford study looks at Ethiopia

slides.title: refugees live in Ethiopia
slides.body: Most come from South Sudan, Somalia, Eritrea and Sudan.

slides.title: of them are children
slides.body: Including 31,000 children separated from their parents or guardians.

slides.title: of child protection needs were funded in 2025
slides.body: UNHCR's Ethiopia operation was less than one-third funded overall.

slides.title: children helped to trace or reunite with family
slides.body: Support fell by more than half from 2024 to 2025.

slides.title: refugee children in 57 schools hit by shortfalls
slides.body: The study warns cuts raise risks of trafficking and exploitation.

slides.title: Protect refugee children and keep their protection services running.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
